title: KNIGHTLE - a wordle-like daily dungeon crawler (with online duels and custom matches)
author: Tryndakels
selftext:
I’ve been building KNIGHTLE, a daily fantasy word-combat game, using ChatGPT/Astra.  
The game runs in a browser on mobile and desktop. You guess words to damage enemies, your health carries between fights, and each enemy has its own mechanic. There’s also permanent progression, knight customization, hard mode, online duels, 2v2s, and King of the Hill.  
My workflow has mostly been deciding how something should work, having AI implement it, then playing it on my phone and sending back screenshots with specific corrections. The project uses HTML, CSS, and JavaScript and is hosted on Cloudflare Pages.  
One of the biggest headaches has been mobile layouts. Multiplayer needs portraits, health bars, word boards, a turn timer, and a keyboard on one screen. Things that looked fine in a preview were getting cut off by the browser bars on my iPhone. Some attempts to fix that shrank everything so much that it looked worse. We’ve had to go back through the layout and decide what actually needs the space.  
Another change came from watching people visit the site without playing. The game originally put a login screen in front of them. I changed the flow so new visitors get the tutorial and go straight into a daily quest as a guest, with account creation offered later.

You can try it here: knightle.io. It’s free to play, with an optional paid Royal Deed upgrade that includes bonuses and cosmetics. I’m the creator.
